title: Getting set up
intro: Almost there. Work down the list to get the most out of the alumni network.

email.title: Confirm your email
email.body: Used to sign in and for notices.

apply.title: Send the verification form
apply.body: Tell us about your time at AIS. The committee will check it.

approval.title: Committee approval
approval.body: Alumni volunteers on the committee are reviewing your details. We'll email you once approved (usually within a few days).

line.title: Link LINE and add us as a friend
line.body: Get chat mentions and important notices on LINE. Just tap the button and sign in with LINE.

photo.title: Add a profile photo
photo.body: A face makes it easier for old friends to find you.

bio.title: Write a short bio
bio.body: What you're up to, where you live — a line is enough.

history.title: Add schools and work
history.body: Add the schools and workplaces after AIS to connect with people from the same places.

follow.title: Follow classmates and teachers
follow.body: Find people you know in the directory and follow them.

family.title: Link your family
family.body: Connect parents, children, siblings and other family members. Children's status updates automatically, and you see each other on the family page.

names.title: Add your name in kanji and kana
names.body: Japanese classmates and teachers can then find you by name. Skip it if you don't have a kanji name.

schoolEmail.title: Confirm your school email
schoolEmail.body: Current staff need to confirm their @aisnagoya.net address. Send yourself a code from Settings.
